selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, tail of /var/log/secure showed only generic PAM session opened/closed lines with no COMMAND= text; explicit grep for COMMAND= in secure log post-reboot returned no matches

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: node identity =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

echo "== configure sudo dedicated logging =="
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-logfile > /dev/null
Defaults    logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults    log_input, log_output
Defaults    !syslog
EOF
sudo -n chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-logfile

echo "== validate sudoers syntax =="
sudo -n visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-logfile

echo "== ensure log file exists with correct perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chmod 0600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== ensure logrotate for the new file (optional best practice) =="
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/logrotate.d/sudo-commands > /dev/null
/var/log/sudo-commands.log {
    missingok
    notifempty
    weekly
    rotate 8
    compress
    create 0600 root root
}
EOF

echo "== verify current messages/secure log tail before test (baseline) =="
sudo -n tail -n 3 /var/log/secure || true
sudo -n tail -n 3 /var/log/messages || true

echo "== run a test sudo command to generate a log entry =="
sudo -n whoami

echo "== show new dedicated log content =="
sudo -n cat /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== confirm no new entry in /var/log/secure or /var/log/messages for this sudo command =="
sudo -n tail -n 5 /var/log/secure || true
sudo -n tail -n 5 /var/log/messages || true

echo "DONE"
